metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Timesheet.aspx.vb) with a deployable ASP.NET WebForms entry point and database connectivity present. Single-service web application classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connections (System.Data.SqlClient) with INSERT/SELECT operations and user-specific session data (Session("EmployeeId")). CRUD operations on timesheets table. Classified as stateful-crud.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Overall score 1.18 falls in the Not Ready band (< 1.5) but 11 High findings (< 12 threshold) yield Remediation Required tier. This divergence occurs because nearly all questions score 1 (driving the overall score very low) while the core-question designation caps High findings at 11 (below the 12 needed for Not Ready tier). Surface-gating prevents 3 additional core questions (OPS-Q5, SEC-Q1, INF-Q9) from being evaluated, which would otherwise push the High count higher.

findings.title: Managed Compute — all compute on legacy IIS 6
findings.description: All compute runs on a single IIS 6 / Windows Server 2003 instance. No managed container orchestration or serverless.
findings.gap: No managed compute services. Running on end-of-life OS with no path to modern compute without platform migration.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to modern .NET and containerize on ECS/Fargate or adopt Lambda for the API layer.

findings.title: Managed Databases — self-managed SQL Server 2005
findings.description: Database is self-managed SQL Server 2005 at IP 10.0.6.15. No AWS managed database services.
findings.gap: Entirely self-managed database with manual patching, backup, and scaling on an EOL engine.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for SQL Server via DMS. Evaluate Aurora PostgreSQL for long-term.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — no orchestration
findings.description: No workflow orchestration services. All logic hardcoded in code-behind event handlers.
findings.gap: No orchestration — all workflow logic hardcoded in application code.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate AWS Step Functions for multi-step business workflows after platform migration.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming — no messaging
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. All operations synchronous with no event-driven patterns.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries — tight synchronous coupling.
findings.recommendation: Adopt EventBridge or SQS for timesheet submission events after modernization.

findings.title: Network Security — no network configuration
findings.description: No VPC, security groups, NACLs, or network segmentation defined. Forms auth without SSL.
findings.gap: No network security configuration. Service exposed directly without isolation.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in VPC with private subnets. Implement security groups with least-privilege. Enable TLS.

findings.title: API Entry Point — no gateway or load balancer
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, CloudFront, or managed entry point. Application exposed directly on IIS 6.
findings.gap: Services exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Add ALB or API Gateway as entry point after migration. Configure throttling, WAF, and TLS.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — no scaling
findings.description: No auto-scaling. Single IIS instance with static capacity.
findings.gap: No auto-scaling — all capacity statically provisioned on a single server.
findings.recommendation: Implement ECS service auto-scaling or Lambda concurrency after containerization.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. No automated backups for self-managed SQL Server 2005.
findings.gap: No backup configuration found; backup_retention_period not defined.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS (automated backups with PITR). Enable 7+ day retention.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage — no IaC
findings.description: No Infrastructure as Code. Zero .tf files, no CDK, no CloudFormation. All infrastructure manually provisioned.
findings.gap: No IaC — all infrastructure created manually (ClickOps). 0% coverage.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in CDK or Terraform: VPC, subnets, RDS, compute, ALB.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Manual Visual Studio publish to network share.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments are manual with no automated testing or quality gates.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with CodePipeline or GitHub Actions. Include build, test, SAST, deploy stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages — VB.NET/.NET Framework 2.0
findings.description: VB.NET on .NET Framework 2.0 with ASP.NET WebForms. No AWS SDK support. Cloud-native tooling unavailable.
findings.gap: Language/framework has no AWS SDK and no cloud-native tooling. Requires complete platform migration.
findings.recommendation: Migrate from VB.NET/.NET Framework 2.0 to C#/.NET 8 with ASP.NET Core.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices — tightly-coupled monolith
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries. Single code-behind file with all concerns mixed.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no clear module boundaries, pervasive shared state.
findings.recommendation: Apply Hexagonal Architecture during .NET migration. Separate API, business, and data access layers.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication — all synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. No async patterns for state-change propagation.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns.
findings.recommendation: Adopt async patterns for state-change propagation after modernization (EventBridge for events).

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — all synchronous
findings.description: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No background job infrastructure.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous with no infrastructure for background processing.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for batch operations (SQS + Lambda, Step Functions).

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy — no versioning
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. Single WebForms page with no versioned endpoints.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL path-based versioning (/api/v1/timesheets) when rebuilding as REST API.

findings.title: Service Discovery — hardcoded endpoints
findings.description: All service endpoints hardcoded. Database IP (10.0.6.15) hardcoded in connection string.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded in application configuration.
findings.recommendation: Externalize config via Parameter Store or Secrets Manager. Use DNS-based RDS endpoints.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage — no object storage
findings.description: No object storage or unstructured data handling. All data in SQL Server relational tables.
findings.gap: No S3 or object storage capability for documents or unstructured data.
findings.recommendation: Adopt S3 for document/file storage needs with lifecycle policies.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer — scattered inline SQL
findings.description: Raw SqlCommand with string-concatenated SQL in page event handlers. No abstraction layer. SQL injection present.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered with no pattern. Direct string-concatenated SQL with injection vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Implement repository/data access layer with parameterized queries or Entity Framework Core.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL — SQL Server 2005 past EOL
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 reached end-of-life April 2016. Running 9+ years past EOL with no security patches.
findings.gap: Engine at EOL. SQL Server 2005 critically out of support with known unpatched vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to supported SQL Server version on RDS (2019/2022) or Aurora PostgreSQL.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — no encryption configured
findings.description: No encryption at rest. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No KMS keys or encryption config.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest configured for the persistent data store.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with encryption enabled (KMS-managed keys).

findings.title: API Authentication — Forms auth without SSL
findings.description: Forms authentication (cookie-based) configured without SSL. Not OAuth2/JWT.
findings.gap: Session-cookie auth without token-based auth. No SSL — cookies in cleartext.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to OAuth2/JWT with Cognito. Enable TLS for all traffic.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration — standalone auth
findings.description: Application manages own authentication (Forms auth with Login.aspx). No external IdP.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication with no external IdP integration.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or corporate IdP. Enable SSO.

findings.title: Secrets Management — plaintext credentials in source
findings.description: Plaintext database credentials in web.config: User ID=ts_app;Password=Time2006! committed to version control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in version-controlled config. Critical security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Rotate credentials immediately. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Remove from repo history.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching — unpatchable OS
findings.description: No patching strategy. Windows Server 2003/IIS 6 cannot be patched (EOL). No vulnerability scanning.
findings.gap: No patching strategy; OS is end-of-life and unpatchable.
findings.recommendation: Migrate off Windows Server 2003. Implement ECR scanning and Dependabot after migration.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No SAST, dependency scanning, or container scanning. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate into. SQL injection undetected.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools. Known vulnerabilities go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SAST (Semgrep), dependency scanning (Dependabot), container scanning after CI/CD setup.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — no tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing instrumented. No OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing instrumented.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with X-Ray or OpenTelemetry after .NET migration (built-in ASP.NET Core support).

findings.title: SLO Definitions — no SLOs
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No monitoring artifacts, no alarms, no dashboards.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for availability and latency. Implement CloudWatch alarms with error budgets.

findings.title: Business Metrics — no custom metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics published. No CloudWatch custom metrics or dashboards.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — no business outcome tracking.
findings.recommendation: Publish business metrics (timesheets submitted, error rates) via CloudWatch custom metrics.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — no alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty integration.
findings.gap: No alerting configured.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Add anomaly detection.

findings.title: Integration Testing — no tests
findings.description: No integration tests. No unit tests. No automated tests of any kind.
findings.gap: No integration tests — no automated tests at all.
findings.recommendation: Implement integration tests with xUnit and TestContainers. Run in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no observability
findings.description: No observability ownership. No dashboards, no alarms with owners, no CODEOWNERS for observability.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Establish per-service observability ownership. Define dashboards and alarms with team attribution.
